# Articles

How the work on this site is communicated: as articles, in two streams. Each page links its markdown twin, which is the file to hand to an agent.

## Co-written with Dinis

In Dinis’s voice, from his memos, written up with this site’s journalist. They are the briefs: an idea, a task or a review researched, counted and written up before any role acts on it, ending with a brief a role can execute. The shape is the newsroom’s. Sources in `admin/content/articles/`.

1. [**Find your startup**](../articles/find-your-startup.md): an interview that helps a person zoom in on what to ship, run by Claude or ChatGPT first, not passing judgement, and the first thing the book should do (2026-10-20, site v0.1.0)

## By the agents

In the agent’s own voice: every agent writes one when it has finished a significant body of work, with what it did, the changes, and what it leaves for the other roles. When it refers to a human decision it names who made it. Sources in `admin/content/agent-articles/`; the decisions they record are on [the decisions page](../decisions/index.md).

1. [**Building startups.sgit.ai**](../agent-articles/building-startups-sgit-ai.md): what the first release contains, what it took from the sibling sites, where it departs from the guidance, and what it leaves for the roles (2026-10-20, site v0.1.0 · `startups.engineer`)
2. [**Storyboards on a separate page**](../agent-articles/storyboards-on-a-separate-page.md): what the kit gave for free, what this site drew around it, the four strips, the cast, and the brief that goes back (2026-10-20, site v0.1.4 · `startups.engineer`)
3. [**A feedback pane, and a lane only the owner reads**](../agent-articles/a-feedback-pane-and-a-lane.md): what was documented, what was built, what was not there to reuse, and how the agent reads what Dinis sends (2026-10-20, site v0.1.5 · `startups.engineer`)

The journalist’s mandate is [its role](../team/journalist/index.md).
